name: Satisfactory (DXMT — crashes)
notes: REJECTED 5 Aug: DXMT loads Apple M4 FL11_1 then RHIThread assert TOptional<FTimestampCalibration> unset (UE D3D11RHI). Factory Crash Reporter. Keep for science; use satisfactory (D3DMetal) to play. RE-TEST BEFORE TRUSTING THAT REJECTION: it was measured against the June DXMT, whose DLLs were built with meson's wine_builtin_dll default of true. Those are stamped 'Wine builtin DLL' at offset 0x40, so Wine's load_builtin() rewrote =n,b into =b,n and searched the tree first — a run recorded as DXMT on that build may have been D3DMetal all along. Solarpunk failed the same way and then ran clean on a v0.80 build made with -Dwine_builtin_dll=false (6 Sep, see solarpunk-dxmt). Check the 'Chosen D3D11 Adapter' line before recording any result here.
